universities.research_notes: Sourced from the official UGA Greek Life 'Councils and Chapters' page. The page's IFC section header states '28 Chapters' but 33 names were present in the extracted list, and the MGC header states '10 Chapters' but only 8 names were present — likely a page-rendering/extraction artifact (the automated fetch may have merged adjacent council sections). Lambda Theta Phi and Lambda Upsilon Lambda appeared in both the IFC and MGC portions of the extraction; Delta Epsilon Psi and Lambda Phi Epsilon appeared only under IFC despite being nationally MGC-type organizations elsewhere — all four flagged needs_review rather than guessed. Panhellenic Council (20 chapters, e.g. Alpha Chi Omega, Chi Omega, Kappa Kappa Gamma, etc.) was also listed on the source page but is out of scope for this research pass. Recommend a human re-verify the IFC/MGC boundary directly against greeklife.uga.edu before using the four flagged entries.

universities.research_notes: IMPORTANT: Per Duke's own official Student Affairs page, Duke currently has NO active, university-recognized IFC or Panhellenic chapters. Following Duke's 2021 decision to end first-year recruitment for Greek/selective living groups, most IFC fraternities disaffiliated from the university in 2021 (with a few later disaffiliations in 2022/2023) and all listed Panhellenic sororities also disaffiliated in 2021; three additional fraternities (Delta Sigma Phi, Kappa Sigma, Sigma Alpha Epsilon) were separately derecognized by the university in 2013/2019. These are recorded here with status='inactive' since the official source explicitly states they are disaffiliated/derecognized (not merely 'unknown') — do NOT treat any of these IFC/Panhellenic entries as currently operating, recognized Duke chapters. Only the MGC (5 chapters) and NPHC (7 chapters, all with local founding dates on the source page) are currently active, university-recognized councils at Duke as of this research.
